_note: OWNER: Smaran. Read by packages/rental_core/test/money_test.dart and mirrored by the SQL tests (Srijan, supabase/tests/phase1_regression.test.sql). Money is whole NPR. Dart works in basis points (depositRateBps 2000 = 20%, commissionRateBps 1000 = 10%); the database stores the same rates as fractions (depositRate 0.2, commissionRate 0.1). minDepositAmount is whole NPR, 0 means no minimum (a case without the field means 0). Deposit = max(round half up(declaredValue x depositRate), minDepositAmount). Approved in contract v0.3: 20% deposit, 10% commission, 1.5x late-fee multiplier, half-up whole-NPR rounding. Minimum deposit approved with the supervisor on 23 Nov 2026 (contract v1.0 section 3.4). The lateFee cases are PROVISIONAL: grace period, late-day rounding and the cap are not approved yet. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, end date inclusive.
